info.name: Create an Api With Tyk Oas Format.

params.name: base_api_id
params.description: The base API which the new version will be linked to.

params.name: base_api_version_name
params.description: The version name of the base API while creating the first version. This doesn't have to be sent for the next versions but if it is set, it will override base API version name.

params.name: new_version_name
params.description: The version name of the created version.

params.name: set_default
params.description: If true, the new version is set as default version.

info.name: Update a Tyk Oas Api Definition.

params.name: apiID
params.description: ID of the API you want to fetch

items.docs:
Updating an API definition uses the same signature an object as a `POST`, however it will first ensure that the API ID that is being updated is the same as the one in the object being `PUT`.


      Updating will completely replace the file descriptor and will not change an API Definition that has already been loaded, the hot-reload endpoint will need to be called to push the new definition
to live.
